scope: Pure calendar/CSV logic, API boundaries and renderer contracts; not DOM or browser behavior

checks.name: Leap years and calendar date validity
Date arithmetic crosses leap day and year without timestamp conversion
Week, month and trailing range presets are exact inclusive calendar dates
CSV BOM, quoted comma, escaped quote and embedded newline
TSV pasted from spreadsheet preserves leading zero IDs
Roster rejects missing fields, duplicate and previously imported IDs
Roster input limits and malformed quotes reject explicitly
Custom table records and columns render without course-only dependencies
Table duplicate IDs and missing column keys reject
User-configured text is escaped in date, resource, organization and table
Workspace remains an empty business slot without default publishing or editor
All current catalog components and page patterns render
